title: docs(skills, adr): objectstack-ui states the one-app-per-package rule for app and module packages alike; ADR-0019 and ADR-0130 record the landed defineStack check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUguw85fhBUoaRdxKf9oDCD)_

Fixes #32809

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** UI 技能文档「App Navigation」一段现在写明：应用包（`type: 'app'`）和模块包（`type: 'module'`）都至多放一个应用，多出的应用各自放进一个带着自己对象的模块包。ADR-0019 的状态行和 ADR-0130 的一行事实记录同步记下「模块包的检查已经落地」。
- **为什么改：** #32586 落地后，`defineStack` 也拒绝模块包里的第二个应用；技能文档原句只提应用包，读者会以为模块包可以放多个，写出来才在 `os validate` 被拒。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改文档和决策记录，不改代码和协议；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。技能文档的 token 数不变（3814，正好在上限），新增内容用同一文件里删掉的一句重复话付清。
- **先看：** `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 的「At most one App per package」一段；`docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md` 的状态行和新增的「Enforced for modules since 2026-11-12」一段；`docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md` §1.5 表里 `validateSingleApp` 那一行。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`，预期第一行读「3814 tokens (ceiling 3814; headroom 0)」。
- **需要你做的：** 审阅并批准本 PR（`skills/**` 和 `docs/adr/**` 都是受管面，Tier H）。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § App Navigation.** The rule paragraph said "`defineStack` refuses a second in a `type: 'app'` package" and "a `type: 'module'` package may carry its own app". It now reads: "`defineStack` refuses a second app in a `type: 'app'` and a `type: 'module'` package alike. A suite (an app package plus its modules) may surface more apps: each further app goes in a module of its own with the objects it shows, served under that module's package id and gone when it is disabled." The citation is "ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended". The last sentence (audiences sharing one product stay `requiredPermissions`-gated groups inside one app) is unchanged.
- **Same file, Common Pitfalls 2.** The tail "set it only when you want an explicit grid position" is deleted. It restated the clause before it ("`layout` is optional: omit it and the widget auto-flows"). This is the payment for the paragraph above.
- **`docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md`, status line.** "the `defineStack` check that holds a module package to at most one app" moves from Pending to Landed, with the merge commit of #32792, `9ae829108c`, and its date.
- **Same record, under D3.** The paragraph "Enforced today, and not yet." is kept as written (it is the reading at the amendment, on `main` at `8bfbc4ed`). A dated paragraph is added after it, "Enforced for modules since 2026-11-12.": what `validateSingleApp` judges now, what it still does not judge (other package types, no manifest, `strict: false`), and the two shapes the check does not reach, a flat `composeStacks` and a hand-built `packages[]` body (#32810).
- **`docs/adr/0130-release-artifact-as-co-ownership-boundary.md`, §1.5 fact table.** The row "`validateSingleApp` constrains only `type: 'app'`" keeps its text and gains an in-row note: a reading of 2026-09-01, no longer true since 2026-11-12, with the merge commit and what the function does now.
- **`.changeset/32809-ui-skill-one-app-per-package.md`:** `@objectstack/skills` patch.
- **Not edited:** `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`. See Tests.

## Why

PR #32792 (card #32586) merged as `9ae829108c`. On `main`, `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` is `app` and `module`, and `validateSingleApp` refuses either package type with more than one app, `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`. The skill sentence was written when only an app package was judged. It was not false, but an agent could read it as "a module package may carry several apps", write one, and meet the refusal at `os validate` or `os build`. The contract review of #32792 (comment 6833950860, section ③) named the two ADR records the landing made stale: the ADR-0019 status line with its "Enforced today, and not yet" paragraph, and the ADR-0130 fact row.

## Skills budget

Read on `main` at `2ca09de5` (before) and on this head (after).

| Reading | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, lines | 301 | 301 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, tokens (`check-skills-token-ratchet`) | 3814 of 3814 (15253 priced bytes) | 3814 of 3814 (15256 priced bytes) |
| All 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4604 | 4604 |
| Whole bundle, ratcheted tokens | 187201 of 194017 | 187201 of 194017 |

The App Navigation paragraph grows by 59 bytes and one line. The deletion in Common Pitfalls 2 removes 56 bytes and one line of restatement. No ceiling row moves and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not edited.

## Tests

- No test file changes: the diff is prose and records. No ablation, for the same reason.
- Eval `views-apps-actions-pages.json`, case 2 (the "second app for the support team" prompt), read against the new paragraph. Its expected output says "At most one app per package, so not a second `App.create` here", that the support team is a `requiredPermissions`-gated group inside the app, and that a support product with objects of its own carries its app in its own `type: 'module'` package of the suite. Each of the three is still taught by the paragraph, and each `must_contain` token is still in the bundle. The eval grades the rule for both package types as written and needs no edit.

## Acceptance notes

- **Branch name.** The platform pins this card thread to `claude/project-thread-i844yo`; the claim (6836140314) names it.
- **The ADR-0019 paragraph is annotated, not rewritten.** ADR-0130 D2's recording convention has a governed record amended by an additive note. The status line is the record's bookkeeping line and is edited in place.
- **The claim is as narrow as the enforcement.** The new ADR-0019 paragraph names the two shapes `validateSingleApp` does not judge, with #32810 as their card. The skill does not teach `composeStacks` for suites, so it names no composition option; if #32810 changes what an author must write, that card owes its own skills follow-up.
- **Folded in on the seat's word.** The ADR-0019 status line's other Pending item, the HotCRM suite split (hotcrm#2417), has landed as hotcrm#2430, hotcrm commit `41d301a7bd`; the same status line now records it under 'Landed in HotCRM', commit `fe605fb6`.
- **The card's two out-of-scope notes stay out.** `content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx` and `docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md` state the rule for an app package only. Both stay true and neither is edited.
- **#32664** (pointer lines in ADR-0130 D2 and ADR-0141) waits behind this card. This PR touches ADR-0130 at the §1.5 row only.

## Verification

Every line below was read on head `9e4c8483`, cut from `main` at `2ca09de5`. Head `fe605fb6` adds one commit that edits only the ADR-0019 status line (the fold above); the contract review (comment 6837025180) read that head. `main` has moved since, touching none of this PR's four paths, so the branch is not merged with it.

All 52 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 52 derived, 52 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
